description: Transform Ship or Skip from pure entertainment to utility + entertainment. userStories.title: Create similarity matching algorithm
userStories.description: Create src/lib/similarity.ts with findSimilarCompanies function. Uses keyword tokenization to find YC companies with similar pitches. Returns top matches with similarity scores.
acceptanceCriteria: Function findSimilarCompanies(userPitch, companies) exists in src/lib/similarity.ts
Tokenizes text: lowercase, remove punctuation, split on spaces, filter stop words
Stop words include: the, for, and, that, with, your, a, an, to, of, is, in, on
Calculates similarity as: matching tokens / user tokens
Returns top 10 matches sorted by score descending
Each result includes: company, score (as percentage)
userStories.notes: Simple keyword matching - no need for embeddings or ML

userStories.title: Create Validate API endpoint

acceptanceCriteria: Accepts POST with body: { pitch: string }

Fetches all YC companies from database
Uses similarity algorithm to find matches
similar_companies includes: company data, similarity percentage
category_stats includes: total, unicorn_pct, acquired_pct, dead_pct, active_pct
userStories.notes: Category stats calculated from similar companies, not all companies
